900100.title: The Sensor Fusion Drill
900100.description: Many sensors, one world: the fusion drill.
900100.content:
The Sensor Fusion Drill — Many sensors, one world: the fusion drill.

The sensor fusion drill trains the many-sensors-one-world skill: the lidar, the camera, the IMU — each noisy alone, together the truth. The drill's setup is the disagreement — the sensors conflict, and the solver's filter must reconcile.

The drill's method is the Kalman: the prediction, the update, the covariance — the mathematics of the best guess.

The drill's lesson is the humility: every sensor lies a little, and the fusion tells the truth. The arena drills the fusion; the fusion builds the world.

Key points:
- Many sensors, one world.
- Reconcile the disagreement.
- The Kalman: predict, update.
- Every sensor lies a little.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Sensor Fusion Drill

900101.title: The Gripper Calibration
900101.description: The hand's honesty: calibrating the gripper.
900101.content:
The Gripper Calibration — The hand's honesty: calibrating the gripper.

The gripper calibration teaches the hand's honesty: the two-fingered gripper, the force sensor, the slip detector — the grasp made reliable. The drill's setup is the fragile — the egg, the glass, the ripe fruit — each demanding the exact force.

The drill's method is the feel: the force curve, the slip signal, the release.

The drill's lesson is the gentleness: the strong grip is easy; the exact grip is the skill. The arena calibrates the hand; the hand learns the touch.

Key points:
- The grasp made reliable.
- The fragile: egg, glass, fruit.
- Force curve, slip signal.
- The exact grip is the skill.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Gripper Calibration

900102.title: The Navigation Gauntlet
900102.description: The maze that moves: the navigation trial.
900102.content:
The Navigation Gauntlet — The maze that moves: the navigation trial.

The navigation gauntlet runs the maze that moves: the course reconfigures, the obstacles wander, and the map goes stale. The drill's setup is the dynamic — the solver must replan continuously.

The drill's method is the SLAM: the mapping and the locating, together, in real time.

The drill's lesson is the replanning: the plan is the hypothesis, and the world is the test. The arena gauntlets the navigator; the navigator learns the flow.

Key points:
- The maze reconfigures.
- Replan continuously.
- SLAM: map and locate together.
- The plan is the hypothesis.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Navigation Gauntlet

900103.title: The Human-Robot Relay
900103.description: The handoff: humans and robots as a team.
900103.content:
The Human-Robot Relay — The handoff: humans and robots as a team.

The human-robot relay practices the handoff: the human and the robot as a relay team, passing the task back and forth. The drill's setup is the division — the robot does the precise, the human does the judgment.

The drill's method is the interface: the handoff must be clean, signaled, and safe.

The drill's lesson is the team: the best pair beats the best solo. The arena relays the partners; the partners learn the rhythm.

Key points:
- Human and robot as a team.
- Robot: precise; human: judgment.
- The handoff clean and signaled.
- The pair beats the solo.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Human-Robot Relay

900104.title: The Failure Analysis Lab
900104.description: Breaking robots on purpose: the failure lab.
900104.content:
The Failure Analysis Lab — Breaking robots on purpose: the failure lab.

The failure analysis lab breaks robots on purpose: the drill's curriculum is the failure modes — the sensor blind, the actuator stuck, the software confused. The drill's setup is the fault injection — the failures scripted, the recovery scored.

The drill's method is the post-mortem: the log, the cause, the fix.

The drill's lesson is the antifragility: the robot that fails well survives. The arena labs the failure; the failure teaches the design.

Key points:
- Curriculum of failure modes.
- Fault injection, recovery scored.
- Post-mortem: log, cause, fix.
- Fail well; survive.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Failure Analysis Lab

900105.title: The Swarm Coordination
900105.description: Many robots, one mind: the swarm drill.
900105.content:
The Swarm Coordination — Many robots, one mind: the swarm drill.

The swarm coordination moves many robots as one mind: the drill's fleet — the dozen small robots, the shared goal, the emergent order. The drill's setup is the decentralization — no leader, only the local rules.

The drill's method is the flocking: the separation, the alignment, the cohesion.

The drill's lesson is the emergence: the swarm's intelligence is in the interactions. The arena swarms the fleet; the fleet finds the order.

Key points:
- A dozen robots, one goal.
- No leader; local rules.
- Flocking: separate, align, cohere.
- Intelligence in the interactions.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Swarm Coordination

900106.title: The Manipulation Marathon
900106.description: The long grasp: the manipulation endurance.
900106.content:
The Manipulation Marathon — The long grasp: the manipulation endurance.

The manipulation marathon runs the long grasp: the drill's sequence — the pick, the place, the assembly — repeated for the hour. The drill's setup is the variety: the objects change, the grasps adapt.

The drill's method is the pipeline: the perceive, the plan, the act — the loop that never stops.

The drill's lesson is the endurance: the reliable grasp, the thousandth time. The arena marathons the hand; the hand learns the long.

Key points:
- Pick, place, assemble, repeat.
- Objects change; grasps adapt.
- Perceive, plan, act — the loop.
- Reliable on the thousandth.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Manipulation Marathon

900107.title: The Perception Puzzle
900107.description: Seeing the scene: the perception challenge.
900107.content:
The Perception Puzzle — Seeing the scene: the perception challenge.

The perception puzzle challenges the seeing: the drill's scene — the clutter, the occlusion, the trick of the light — and the solver must find the target. The drill's setup is the hard case: the transparent, the reflective, the tiny.

The drill's method is the segmentation: the pixels to objects, the objects to poses.

The drill's lesson is the seeing: the perception is the robot's first sense. The arena puzzles the eye; the eye learns the scene.

Key points:
- The cluttered, occluded scene.
- The hard: transparent, reflective, tiny.
- Segmentation: pixels to poses.
- Perception is the first sense.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Perception Puzzle

900108.title: The Safety Cage
900108.description: The rules that protect: the safety drill.
900108.content:
The Safety Cage — The rules that protect: the safety drill.

The safety cage teaches the rules that protect: the drill's curriculum is the safe operation — the e-stop, the speed limit, the human zone. The drill's setup is the scenario: the human enters, the robot must yield.

The drill's method is the verification: the safety rated, the monitored, the proven.

The drill's lesson is the trust: the safe robot is the trusted robot. The arena cages the danger; the cage builds the trust.

Key points:
- E-stop, speed limits, human zones.
- The human enters; the robot yields.
- Safety rated and monitored.
- The safe robot is trusted.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Safety Cage

900109.title: The Arena Championship
900109.description: The capstone: the tournament of the arenas.
900109.content:
The Arena Championship — The capstone: the tournament of the arenas.

The arena championship is the capstone: the tournament of the arenas — the twelve challenges, the ranked teams, the crowned builders. The championship's format is the decathlon: the perception, the manipulation, the navigation — the complete robot.

The championship's spirit is the learning: the teams share the designs, and the arena advances.

The championship's lesson is the community: the builders compete, and the field grows. The championship crowns; the arena teaches.

Key points:
- Twelve challenges, one decathlon.
- The complete robot, tested.
- Teams share the designs.
- Compete; the field grows.

demo.title: Guided reading demo — The Arena Championship
